536b2d17ad08b9d99d5fddeec31a81951dc679a3.sourceText: 节点只有在scan输出存在订阅者时才订阅cloud_in；最后一个扫描订阅者消失后，会取消点云订阅。输入和输出均使用SensorDataQoS；兼容的订阅QoS与有效TF是收到扫描的前提。全是被过滤的点时，仍可发布一帧全为无回波值的扫描，不能把“有扫描消息”视为障碍轮廓正确。
536b2d17ad08b9d99d5fddeec31a81951dc679a3.translatedText: The node subscribes cloud_in only when there is a subscriber to the scan output; after the last scan subscriber disappears, it unsubscribes from the point cloud\. Both input and output use SensorDataQoS; compatible subscription QoS and a valid TF are prerequisites for receiving scans\. Even when all points are filtered out, a scan frame consisting entirely of no\-return values can still be published; therefore, the presence of a scan message must not be taken as an indication that the obstacle contour is correct\.
